A real before and after

From Agent-Ready Store Audit, one of the skills in this pack. Taken from its README. See the full skill page.

Before: a well-known coffee brand's Shopify store looks complete in a browser, with prices, variants, Shop Pay and a refund page.

After (excerpt from the skill's report, 3 October 2026):

Score: 77/100. Agents can reach the store and read prices, but can't answer shipping, returns or review questions.
Agent Q&A test: 6/12 answered. Shipping cost/time: Not found on both pages. Returns: Not found (footer link only).
1. Add a "Shipping & returns" block to product pages · Impact: High · Effort: 5 min. Online Store → Themes → Customize → Product template → Add block → Collapsible tab…
2. Write the shipping policy: /policies/shipping-policy has 0 words.

(Store names are left out on purpose. Full test logs are kept internally.)

On a second store (an apparel brand), the audit found product pages with no JSON-LD and the price only in JavaScript. In a browser nothing looks wrong, but an agent reading the page can't quote a price.

How it was tested

Every skill in the pack was tested on real public Shopify stores or real public merchant cases and scored against a written rubric. Each ships only when every test scores 8/10 or more.

Works with

Works with any assistant that reads SKILL.md skills (Claude, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and others), plus a paste-in prompt version for ChatGPT or any chatbot. We run our release tests on Claude Sonnet and Opus. Use your assistant's strongest model: in our tests, a small, fast model added facts that were not in the source data.

Install

  1. Unzip the download. It holds one folder per skill, a README and the licence.
  2. Put each skill folder where your assistant looks for skills. The generic path is .agents/skills/ (or npx skills add from a folder). Tool-specific paths:
    • Claude Code: ~/.claude/skills/ (or .claude/skills/ inside one project)
    • OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and others: .agents/skills/ or the skills folder their docs name
    • claude.ai: zip the skill folder yourself, then Customize, Skills, the plus button, Create skill, Upload a skill (code execution must be on in Settings, Capabilities)
    • ChatGPT or any chatbot: open the skill's prompt.md, paste it into the chat, then paste your own text or link
    • Steps for each tool, with links to its official docs: how to install Agent Skills
  3. Ask for the job in plain words. The skill loads by itself.
